requirements.quote: Neutral-citation patterns for SC (`YYYY INSC N`), Madras HC and Karnataka HC (`YYYY:MHC:N`, `YYYY:KHC:N`) and common reporters (SCC, SCC OnLine, AIR, MLJ, ILR) are extracted from text with spans mapped to block ids [type:unit]
On the labelled fixture set the false-verified rate is at most 0.5% and every fabricated citation resolves to `not_found` or `unknown`, never `verified` [type:unit]
A citation is `verified` only on an exact structured match and a title similarity at or above a configured threshold; ambiguous matches are `unknown` [type:unit]
No code path generates, completes, corrects or suggests a citation; static test greps the package for AI calls inside `citations/` and fails if any exist [type:unit]
The resolver stores only citation string, status, canonical URL and short title; no judgment text is persisted [type:api]
With `CITATION_RESOLVER=mock` (default when no token is set) the checker runs fully offline in dev and CI [type:api]
Resolver outage, timeout or rate-limit yields `unknown` with reason `resolver_unavailable`, never `verified`, and the job retries with backoff [type:api]
`acknowledgeUnverified` is required to export a draft containing any `not_found` citation; the acknowledgement stores actor, time, reason and citation ids in `audit_event` [type:api]
Editing a cited span invalidates its previous status and re-queues the check; stale statuses are never shown as current [type:api]
Per-workspace resolver rate limit and daily budget are enforced and visible in the report as `throttled` [type:unit]
`authority` has RLS on `workspace_id` and is covered by the cross-tenant suite [type:api]
Official links open as plain external links intended for a new window; no court page is framed and nothing is scraped [type:manual]
The check job p95 is under 5 s for a 10-citation draft against the mock resolver [type:unit]
at least 200 labelled cases: valid, fabricated, near-miss
Job `drafting.citations.check` payload `{workspaceId, draftVersionId}`; emits `draft.citations.checked`.
`CitationReport = { draftVersionId, items: Array<{ id, blockId, span:[start,end], raw, normalized, kind, status, sourceUrl?, reason? }>, counts:{verified,not_found,unknown} }`
`packages/config/src/env.ts` (add `INDIAN_KANOON_API_TOKEN` optional, `CITATION_RESOLVER=mock|indian-kanoon`)
Never log draft text; log citation strings only at debug level and never with matter identifiers.
Out of scope**: UI for statuses and the acknowledgement dialog (#79); research link-outs (#80); the consistency checker (#78).
requirements.evidence: .forge-lean/investigation.md: issue marks UI (#79), link-outs (#80) and consistency checker (#78) out of scope; open issues #78 and #79 cover them

deliverables.change: zod `CitationSchema`, `CitationStatus = 'verified'|'not_found'|'unknown'`, `CitationKind`, reason enum (resolver_unavailable, throttled, ambiguous, ...), `CitationReport` type. Add the `./citation` subpath to packages/validators/package.json (mirror `./drafting`).
Add `./citation` export mirroring `./drafting`.
Regexes for INSC, MHC, KHC neutral citations and SCC, SCC OnLine, AIR, MLJ, ILR reporters, plus `Party v. Party`.
Canonical form of each citation kind (whitespace, punctuation, court code case); reuse nothing that imports db.

`extractCitations(blocks)` walks the block tree with `walkBlocks` (text of heading, paragraph, section title) and returns `{blockId (block key), span:[start,end], raw, normalized, kind}`; deterministic ids so a version's citation set is reproducible.

Pure `classify(citation, resolverResult, {titleThreshold})`: verified only on exact normalised structured match plus title similarity at or above threshold; ambiguous or multiple matches give unknown; no hit on a definitive resolver gives not_found; outage gives unknown/resolver_unavailable. Store only citation, status, sourceUrl, short title (truncate title).
Deterministic offline resolver fixtures; default resolver.
API client over injectable fetch: timeout, retry with jitter, maps HTTP 429/5xx/timeouts to a typed unavailable outcome; returns only citation, canonical URL and short title, never judgment text.
Pure link builders for SC and HC neutral-citation portals (strings only, no fetch, no scraping).
Per-workspace token-bucket limiter with injectable clock; returns throttled outcome.
Barrel for the citations module; re-export from packages/drafting/src/index.ts (see D12).
Re-export the citations public surface.

Unit tests: extraction spans and block ids per pattern, classify thresholds, outage/throttle, official links, mock offline, p95 under 5 s for 10 citations, false-verified rate at most 0.5% on the fixture set, every fabricated case never verified.
At least 200 labelled cases (valid, fabricated, near-miss) used by the mock resolver and the rate test.

Static test: reads every file under citations/ and fails on imports or identifiers of `@causedeck/ai`, `narrative`, `draftNarrative`, gateway or any generate/complete/suggest call (model on packages/core/src/automation/no-l5.test.ts).

Tenant table `authority` (id, draft_version_id, block_id, span, raw_text, normalized, kind, resolution jsonb of {reason,title,similarity,source}, status, source_url, checked_at, ack_by, ack_at) via `tenantTable`, composite FK to draft_version(workspace_id,id) as in draftExport, unique on (draft_version_id, block_id, span), check on status/kind. No judgment-text column.

Use the next free timestamp after the newest file on the base; add meta/<ts>_snapshot.json and the _journal.json entry (generate with drizzle-kit, do not hand-edit the snapshot).

Register `authority` in the table map (DB_TABLES_TEST or TABLE_TESTS plus seeders as the registry requires) and add the new core drafting exports to SERVICE_TESTS (or NOT_A_SERVICE with a reason for pure helpers).
Real cases: workspace B cannot read, check or acknowledge workspace A's citation report (denied or sees nothing; A unchanged). Keep the addition small (hotspot file).

`checkDraft(deps, actor|system, draftVersionId)`: load version content, `extractCitations`, resolve via the configured resolver under limiter plus daily budget (count of today's external-resolver rows per workspace), classify, upsert `authority` rows idempotently on (draft_version_id, block_id, span), record `draft.citations.checked` audit (counts only), return `CitationReport` (counts include throttled as unknown with reason `throttled`, listed separately in the report). `getCitationReport` returns only statuses for the requested version (draft.read). Never log draft text; citation strings at debug only.

`acknowledgeUnverified(deps, actor, {draftVersionId, citationIds, reason})`: requires `draft.export`, sets ack_by/ack_at on the not_found rows, writes `draft.citations.acknowledged` audit_event with actor, time, reason and citation ids in the same transaction. Plus `exportBlockedByCitations` helper.

`saveVersion`/`restoreVersion` accept an optional `enqueueCitationCheck` dep and call it after the insert (new version has no statuses until checked); `exportDraft` refuses with a CONFLICT-type error when the version has any unacknowledged not_found citation, or has unchecked citations (extract and compare to stored rows, running `checkDraft` first).
`runDraftingExport` applies the same gate (defence in depth, since the job can be enqueued directly); refusal is a `WorkspaceError` so the job wrapper makes it permanent.
Export checkDraft, getCitationReport, acknowledgeUnverified and their types (other domains import only this file).

`defineJob` `drafting.citations.check`, payload `{workspaceId, draftVersionId}` (zod), singleton/idempotent on draftVersionId, retries with backoff; transient resolver unavailability leaves the row unknown/resolver_unavailable and rethrows a retryable error until the last attempt; permanent errors (missing version, WorkspaceError) use PermanentError. Exports `enqueueDraftingCitationCheck` like `enqueueDraftingExport`.
Register the new job and its enqueue wiring next to draftingExport (:48,189,250).
Add `drafting.citations.check` to the expected job list (:146 area).
Add `draft.citations.checked` and `draft.citations.acknowledged` (security:false for checked, true for acknowledged) to the action registry.

Add optional secret `INDIAN_KANOON_API_TOKEN` and enum `CITATION_RESOLVER=mock|indian-kanoon` (default mock; indian-kanoon requires the token; production default stays mock until #114). Update any generated env docs or key-registry tests that enumerate keys.

Testcontainers test: check a version with mock resolver (verified, not_found, unknown), idempotent rerun, new version has no statuses, ack required then export allowed, ack audit row content, outage gives unknown/resolver_unavailable, daily budget gives throttled, no draft text in log output.

decisions.choice: Pure extract/match/resolve code lives in packages/drafting/src/citations; the DB-backed `checkDraft` and `acknowledgeUnverified` live in packages/core/src/drafting, not in packages/drafting as the issue's file list says.
decisions.justification: packages/drafting/package.json depends only on ai and validators; adding @causedeck/db would be a new workspace dependency, and the existing split (engine pure, service in core) is the #768 precedent (packages/core/src/drafting/service.ts).

decisions.choice: The job is a core job definition (packages/core/src/jobs/definitions/drafting-citations-check.ts) registered in jobs/registry.ts, not apps/worker/src/jobs/check-citations.ts.
decisions.justification: All jobs including drafting.export are defined in core and only listed in apps/worker/src/__tests__/registry.test.ts:146.

decisions.choice: Migration at packages/db/migrations with timestamp name instead of packages/db/drizzle/00xx, and tests in src/__tests__ instead of test/.
decisions.justification: Repo layout: packages/db/migrations/20261025225346_drafting_export.sql and meta/_journal.json; vitest includes src.

decisions.choice: Statuses attach to immutable draft_version_id; an edit creates a new version with no authority rows, which is how stale statuses are invalidated and a re-check queued.
decisions.justification: draft_version is immutable by trigger (packages/db/src/schema/drafting.ts:108-131), so rows cannot go stale in place.

decisions.choice: The per-workspace daily budget is counted from authority rows (external-resolver rows checked today) rather than a new usage table; the rate limit is an in-memory token bucket.
decisions.justification: Avoids a second table and migration; AI budgets in packages/ai/usage are LLM-spend specific and not reusable for resolver calls.

decisions.choice: No new policy action: report reads use draft.read, check uses draft.write, acknowledgement uses draft.export.
decisions.justification: packages/auth/src/policy/actions.ts:14 and matrix.ts:30-32 already define them, with clerk restrictions via JUNIOR_MATTER_SCOPED.
